transcript.text: theres water in the bottom of my frige under the salad draws, keeps comming back after i mop it up

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. Water pooling under the salad drawers that keeps returning is almost always caused by a blocked defrost drain. When the fridge cycles off and frost melts on the back wall, that water should run down a small hole at the bottom of the rear panel into a tray underneath to evaporate. If that hole gets clogged with food particles or gunk, the water has nowhere to go but onto your shelves. Please check inside the fridge compartment: look at the bottom of the back wall for a small drain hole or channel. Is it visible and clear, or does it look blocked? Once you've checked that, let me know what you see.

ok i had a look, theres a little groove and a hole at the bottom of the back wall and its got bits of lettuce and gunk in it. the water is only inside the fridge not near the plug btw. what shud i do to clear it?

To clear it, switch the fridge off and unplug it first. Use a turkey baster or a squeezy bottle filled with warm (not boiling) water to gently flush out the gunk from that hole. If there's still blockage, you can carefully use a flexible pipe cleaner or a length of soft wire to loosen it—just be gentle so you don't poke through the plastic. Once the water flows freely down into the drip tray at the back, wipe everything dry and plug the fridge back in.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
ok i did it with a cotton bud and some warm water, the gunk came out and the water went straight down the hole now. is that all i need to do?

Yes, that is all you need to do for now. Since the water is flowing freely down the hole again, the blockage has been cleared and the pooling should stop. To help prevent it from happening too soon, try to avoid letting food scraps or lettuce leaves get too close to the back wall in future. If the water starts pooling under the salad drawers again after a few days, let me know.
